Sparkman Wharf and the water taxi.verification: Commons file by Jackdude101, titled and described 'The Pirate Water Taxi in Tampa, Florida,' taken 24 July 2021; the boat's hull is lettered PIRATEWATERTAXI.COM and carries the same pirate-flag roundel the real Tampa service uses, so this is the actual vessel the pick names, not a generic boat. Not geotagged, so Sparkman Wharf itself (one of the taxi's stops, per this guide's own Riverwalk pick text) is not provably pictured; the caption and alt therefore describe only the boat, which is what the image actually shows. Live Commons licence checked directly on the file page: CC BY-SA 4.0. A driver and a few riders are visible at a distance, incidental to the boat, which is the photo's clear subject; no one is identifiable as a portrait subject.
